## About
David's Rally Wheels is a tire and wheel shop at 1991 Alum Rock Ave in San Jose. We sell and install wheels and new and used tires, handle alignment and balancing, and work on brakes.
We also specialize in hard-to-find parts, like center caps and trim rings for classic American muscle cars. Whether you're restoring an old Mustang or just need tires for your Subaru, come see what we have.
Not local? Our parts are listed on our eBay store and we ship throughout the world. Customers have given us a 4.5 rating from 232 Google reviews.

## Services
- Wheels: A big selection of wheels for restorations and everyday cars, with wheels and accessories for Camaro, Corvette, Ford, Chevy, Pontiac, Buick, Chrysler and more.
- Tires: New and used tires, including seasonal, all-weather and high-performance, with installation, alignment and balancing.
- Center caps and trim rings: Vintage and modern center caps and trim rings to find the right fit for your wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you repair tires for free?
A: Ask us about free tire repairs when you buy 4 new tires.

Q: Can you ship parts to me?
A: Yes. We ship throughout the world, and our parts are listed on our eBay store. International orders need to be prepaid through PayPal.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cashier's checks, money orders, checks, cash, Visa, MasterCard, American Express and PayPal.

Q: Can I return a part?
A: Returned parts need to be unmounted, in original condition and packaging, and reach us no later than 30 days after sale for a refund. Call or email us first for a return authorization number.

Q: Do you have another location?
A: Yes, we also have a shop at 941 West A St. in Hayward.
